from app.crud.invoices import get_invoices_dynamically

@router.get("", response_model=List[Invoice])
def get_invoices(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Get all invoices with pagination."""
    invoices = db.query(InvoiceModel).offset(skip).limit(limit).all()
    return invoices


@router.get("/customer/{customer_id}", response_model=List[Invoice])
def get_invoices_by_customer(customer_id: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Get all invoices for a specific customer."""
    invoices = db.query(InvoiceModel).filter(InvoiceModel.customer_id == customer_id).all()
    return invoices


@router.get("/{invoice_number}", response_model=Invoice)
def get_invoice(invoice_number: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Get a specific invoice by invoice number."""
    invoice = db.query(InvoiceModel).filter(InvoiceModel.invoice_number == invoice_number).first()
    if not invoice:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            detail=f"Invoice with number {invoice_number} not found"
        )
    return invoice


@router.post("/filter", response_model=List[Invoice])
def filter_invoices(filters: InvoiceFilterParams, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    """Filter invoices based on dynamic criteria."""
    invoices = get_invoices_dynamically(db=db, filters=filters)
    return invoices

def create_invoice(invoice: InvoiceCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

    db_invoice = InvoiceModel(**invoice.model_dump())
    db.add(db_invoice)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_invoice)
    return db_invoice

def update_invoice(invoice_number: int, invoice: InvoiceUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
